snippet.title: Shroom And Gloom Steam Demo and Publisher Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Shroom and Gloom is a first person, roguelike double-deck builder.

Grab the demo and wishlist the game today!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3602770/Shroom_and_Gloom_Demo/

Want more info about the announcement of the Steam Demo and our partnership with Devolver Digital? Check out our first Steam dev log!
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3271280?emclan=103582791475141848&emgid=644688664507449488
